title: CPSC and Chick-fil-A Inc. Announce Recall of "Planet Discovery" Kid's Meal Toy
summary: The suction cup on the toy can come off, presenting a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 3.8 million.

title: CPSC, Supreme Toys Announce Recall of Toy Vehicles
summary: Small parts can break off the toy vehicles, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 290,000.

title: CPSC, National Shooting Sports Foundation Announce Recall to Replace Project HomeSafe (Now Project ChildSafe) Gun Locks
summary: Under certain conditions, these locks can open without the use of a key. This can give unauthorized access to a firearm. Units: About 400,000.

title: CPSC, Pottery Barn Kids Announce Recall of Wooden Pull Toys
summary: Wooden pegs can come off of these pull toys, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 2,900.

title: CPSC, Alene Candles Announce Recall of Christmas Candles
summary: These candles can burn with a high flame, presenting a fire hazard. Units: Approximately 38,000.

title: CPSC, Carrier (Puerto Rico) Inc. Announce Recall of Air Conditioners Sold in Puerto Rico
summary: Condensation inside these air conditioning units can splash onto the control board, causing it to short circuit and start a fire. Units: About 460.

title: CPSC, Kolcraft Announce Recall of Tot Rider Walkers
summary: The cover on the walker's removable music center can break off, allowing small parts to fall from the product, creating a potential choking hazard to young children. Units: About 3,356.

title: CPSC, By Us International Co. Ltd. Announce Expanded Recall of Bicycle Forks Installed on Mountain Bicycles
summary: The forks on these bicycles can break apart, causing riders to lose control and fall. Units: About 40,000.

title: CPSC, NIKE USA Inc. Announce Recall of Jordan Trunner Cross-Training Shoes
summary: The shoes have a thin metal strip on the outside of the heel that can protrude from the shoe and form a sharp edge that can cut consumers. Units: About 225,000.

title: CPSC, The Brinkmann Corporation Announce Recall of Outdoor Solar Lights
summary: The beveled lens on the solar light can act as a magnifying glass. When sunlight passes through the lens, nearby combustible materials, such as mulch or dry grass, can catch on fire. Units: About 79,000.

title: CPSC, AmeriGas Propane L.P. Announce Another Recall of Propane Cylinders
summary: These cylinders could be overfilled, which can cause them to release flammable propane gas unexpectedly, posing a risk of fires and explosions. Units: About 1,600.

title: CPSC, Graco Announce Recall of Highchairs
summary: The chair's legs can come out, causing the chair to fall to the ground. Children can suffer serious injuries from the fall. Units: About 860,000.

title: CPSC, IMT Accessories Announce Recall of BarbieTM Sunglasses
summary: The frames of the sunglasses can break, allowing the petroleum distillate and floating glitter to leak out. Petroleum distillates could be harmful to children's eyes and skin and could be fatal if ingested. Units: About 70,000.

title: CPSC, Simmons Announce Recall to Repair Cribs
summary: Bracket hooks that are used to position the height of the mattress can break, causing the mattress to collapse. Babies can become trapped and suffocate when this happens. Units: More than 68,600.

title: CPSC, The Paper Magic Group Inc. Announce Recall of Christmas Candles
summary: The ceramic handle that extends over the top of the basket can become hot during use, posing a burn hazard, if touched. Units: About 31,000.

title: CPSC, Controlled Energy Corporation Announce Recall of Water Heaters
summary: The heaters can produce dangerous levels of carbon monoxide in the exhaust gas, which can cause serious injuries and death. Units: About 320.

title: CPSC, Pebco Inc. Announce Recall of Hairdryers
summary: These hairdryers have undersized wiring, are not equipped with ground fault circuit interrupters to cut off electrical current in case of contact with water, and have loose electrical connections. The hairdryers pose an electrocution and fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 22,500.

title: Children's Brooms Recalled by EMSCO Inc.
summary: The paint on the handles of these brooms contain high lead levels. CPSC standards ban toys and other children's products containing high levels of lead. Young children could ingest lead from the broom handles, presenting a lead poisoning hazard. Units: About 2,200.

title: CPSC, Dura Kleen (USA) Inc. Announce Recall of Nightlights
summary: The nightlights' electrical connections are loose. They are made from flammable plastic and the power switch does not work. The nightlights pose shock and fire hazards to consumers. Units: About 459,000.

title: Educational Games Recalled by Lakeshore Learning Materials
summary: Metal weights found in the games contain lead, which presents a lead poisoning hazard to children. Lead poisoning in children is associated with behavioral problems, learning disabilities, hearing problems and growth retardation. Units: 13,000.

title: Recent Death Prompts Search for Recalled Play Yards/Cribs
summary: These cribs/play yards can collapse and entrap an infant. Units: About 100,000.

title: Richfood Bleach Recalled by SuperValu Eastern Region
summary: The bottles were mislabeled. The clear plastic 32 oz. bottles were labeled bleach, but contained ammonia. If the ammonia is mixed with bleach or acid, irritating or toxic gasses could be produced. Units: About 500.

title: Toy Drums Recalled by Eden LLC
summary: The mallet sold with the toy drum has spheres on each end that can pose a choking hazard if they become lodged in a young child's throat. Units: About 5,800.
